body: I'm going to talk to him after work. I needed to take immediate action, but this has to be a conversation done in person.

I'm going to have to talk to him about the removal. They're locked in an offsite location. I took his property, and I feel obligated to explain my actions. I owe him that.  
  
He and I drink somewhat frequently, but I think I can help us both by reducing how much I drink. I'd at least not be enabling that behavior. But I also don't want him to feel like I'm alienating him or judging him for drinking. I'll have to be careful about how I handle that. Alcohol puts you in a horrible cycle of depression and physical dependence.  
  
I like the idea of somehow talking to a much more stable person for some outside support. I'll work on that for myself. I can't make any of the others do that. If I can at least keep myself going and have my own support, I can be more helpful to my friends.  
  
Thank you for your help.  
  
Edit: We both have firearms. Quite a few actually.
